Questions

Where is the salon?

Near the old RTO office, in front of Income Tax Colony, Ashapur, Varanasi.

When do you open?

We open at 11:30 am and are busiest from noon to 9 pm.

How do I book?

Use the booking form, call +91 88817 77575, or message us on WhatsApp.

Do you serve both men and women?

Yes. Magic Touch is a family salon for men, women and kids’ haircuts.

How are prices decided?

Prices marked “onwards” start at that amount, and some ranges depend on the work involved. Call us for an exact price.

I am getting married. What should I do?

Send the bridal enquiry form with your wedding date and we will confirm availability.

Ready for a new look?

Pick a service and a time. We will confirm by phone or WhatsApp.
